chunks: Al-Ḥalabī narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام that he said:
"There is no harm in reciting the Talbiyah while you are not in a state of taharah (ritual purity), and in any condition."

key_terms.تُلَبِّيَ: to recite the Talbiyah in the rites of hajj or ihram
key_terms.غَيْرِ طُهْرٍ: without a state of ritual purity
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection

ai.seo_question: Can Talbiyah be recited without taharah (ritual purity)?
ai.summary: This hadith states that reciting the Talbiyah does not require being in a state of taharah (ritual purity). It indicates ease in the rites of hajj and shows that this act of worship may be performed in all conditions.
